question.question: When Vagabond takes hits using allied warriors, when and under what comparison does that ally become Hostile?

expected.expected_answer: If more hits are taken removing allied warriors than damaging items in same battle, ally becomes Hostile at battle end. Equal counts do not. Overrides ordinary first-warrior hostility trigger for these battle losses.

source_passages.section: Actions — Vagabond (9; V.1–3) (Taking hits with an ally)
source_passages.quotation: In a battle using Allied warriors as your own, you may absorb hits by removing those warriors or damaging your items. If you remove **more allied warriors than items you damage in that battle**, the ally becomes Hostile **at battle end**. This overrides ordinary hostility timing for those friendly warriors taken as hits against the other enemy. Equal numbers do not trigger the rule.

answer.ruling: When using Allied warriors as your own in battle, the Vagabond may absorb hits by removing those warriors or damaging items. The ally becomes Hostile at battle end only if more allied warriors were removed than Vagabond items damaged in that battle. Equal numbers do not make the ally Hostile; this special timing overrides ordinary hostility timing for those allied warriors taken as hits against another enemy.
